lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Hello, Maestro.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I have good news.
What is it?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I've finally received my role for our upcoming project.
Which genre is it? Are you taking up the lead role?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: It's a modern opera with a uniquely refined interpretation.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: The role I'll be playing is a princess who is as beautiful as a radiant flower,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: yet her heart is as cold and ruthless as ice.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Naturally, it will be the leading role.
This is just perfect for you!
A breathtakingly beautiful and aloof princess... just like you in every way.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Thank you,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I thought so as well.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Maestro.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I feel you have an erroneous perception of me.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: It's true that I am beautiful, but aloof? Hardly.
I simply meant that the role is perfect for you.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Really? Very well. I misunderstood.
What's it about?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I want you to come and watch for yourself,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: but the first performance is still a long way off,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: so I can give you a little snippet, since I know you're eager to watch it.
Thanks!

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: In the allure of the princess's beauty, countless men

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: come bearing precious treasures, each asking for her hand

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: and pledging undying devotion.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Yet, the princess looks down at these men

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: and poses them a difficult riddle.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Should they solve the riddle, she shall be theirs.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: If they were to get it wrong...
What then?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: They will be executed at once.
Whoa, that's intense.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: The show delves into the idea of how badly you want something,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: and whether you'd be willing to risk your life for it.
Sounds intriguing.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: What about you, Maestro?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Is there anything that you're willing to give your life for?
Reclaiming the surface stolen by the Raptures.
Ensuring everyone leads a peaceful life.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: And you would truly be willing to trade your life for such a thing?
Yes, even if I die trying.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I'm glad I consulted you before starting this new role.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: You've been a big help. Thank you.
Glad that I could help.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Be sure to come watch the performance when it launches.
Of course, I'll be there with flowers.
